topFindings.title: byoniq/AI-Redteaming
topFindings.description: Curated LLM/AI attack tools — prompt injection, jailbreaks, agentic threats, adversarial ML, MCP attack surface

topFindings.title: Marwane-Haddane/Claude_leak
topFindings.description: Cybersecurity analysis of a real-world AI system leak (Claude Code) — reverse engineering architecture, identifying attack surfaces, and exploring jailbreak vectors in agent-based LLM systems

topFindings.title: YanPes/zero-trust-pi-agent-harness
topFindings.description: Hardened Docker wrapper for pi suitable for zero-trust enterprise environments. secure-pi launches pi in a locked-down container with secure defaults, minimizing attack surface while maintaining core functionality for codebase and LLM interactions.

topFindings.title: utkarshrai2811/vanta
topFindings.description: Autonomous red team agent powered by local LLM inference. Maps a network, reasons about the attack surface, validates exploits in sandboxed containers, drafts remediations, and closes the loop on a single board. Built for air-gapped environments and edge hardware (Jetson Orin Nano).

topFindings.title: azdabat/-AI-LLM-Autonomous-Systems
topFindings.description: As AI and autonomous systems become core enterprise infrastructure, the attack surface expands into new territory. This section documents original research applying the MTDF methodology to AI-specific threat classes and agentic pipeline security.

findings.title: Euronii/Reconos
findings.description: Turn OSINT into attack surface intelligence. A multi-agent LLM framework that passively collects 8 data sources and automatically maps exposed infrastructure.

findings.title: gwang1688/Multi-Agentic-AI-Surface-Not-Structure
findings.description: When an LLM agent population shares its surface anchors — its own last move and the letters in its prompt — local bias becomes a population-level, priced attack surface: a game-native exploitability audit.

findings.title: isrivarshini/RedTeaming-LLM-Agents
findings.description: This repository contains over 50 executed adversarial jailbreak attacks on ReAct- and AutoScraper-based LLM agents using the OpenAI API, which surfaced three alignment vulnerabilities and informed hardening strategies.

findings.title: SriyanRavuri/vuln_discovery_agent
findings.description: LLM-driven attack-surface analyser with scope guard and passive recon (whois / DNS / TLS / nmap). Includes mock mode.
